name: UI Design Daily
summary: Gallery of 1500+ free UI designs, each downloadable as an editable source file for Sketch, Figma, XD or Photoshop.
description: A large gallery of free UI components and screens, posted daily since 2016. Designs are tagged by element and topic (card, form, dropdown, pricing, chart, dark mode …) and each can be downloaded as an editable source file for Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop or InVision Studio, under a Creative Commons license.
